e.title: 通用航空保险保费预测（硕士论文）：用交叉验证的 XGBoost 集成加保形预测区间估计公务机年保费，并把 15% 锁住不动；某些候选在锁住测试集上单项指标更好，但该集合未被用来重选模型
e.title_en: General aviation insurance premium prediction (master’s thesis): a cross-validated XGBoost ensemble with conformal prediction intervals for annual premiums, keeping 15% of the data locked — some candidates scored better on individual locked-test metrics, but that set was not used to reselect the model
e.title_hk: 通用航空保險保費預測（碩士論文）：用交叉驗證的 XGBoost 集成加保形預測區間估計公務機年保費，並把 15% 鎖住不動；某些候選在鎖住測試集上單項指標更好，但該集合未被用來重選模型
e.summary: 一份南丹麦大学与 ForeFlight 合作完成的机器学习硕士论文项目：用可观测的保单、飞机与飞行员属性估计通用航空年保费，量化预测不确定性并解释模型主要驱动因素；技术路线是比较基线、GLM、HistGradientBoosting、CatBoost 与多种 XGBoost 变体后选定一个「通用对数保费模型＋分段相对保费模型」的集成，预测区间同时试了原始分位数、保形点方法与保形分位数回归；1,945 条自愿填报的保单记录中 85% 用于开发与五折交叉验证、15% 锁进最终测试集，模型与超参数选择只用开发数据；论文写明「某些附近的提升树候选在锁住测试集的单项指标上表现略好，但测试集没有被用来重选」；最终 90% 对数相对保形区间在锁住测试集上的覆盖率为 92.12%，平均宽度是保费的 1.11 倍；仓库明确列出被排除的内容（原始与处理后的保单级数据、模型二进制、公司往来文件等），并写明因此该公开仓库无法独立复现完整实验
e.summary_hk: 一份南丹麥大學與 ForeFlight 合作完成的機器學習碩士論文項目：用可觀測的保單、飛機與飛行員屬性估計通用航空年保費，量化預測不確定性並解釋模型主要驅動因素；技術路線是比較基線、GLM、HistGradientBoosting、CatBoost 與多種 XGBoost 變體後選定一個「通用對數保費模型＋分段相對保費模型」的集成，預測區間同時試了原始分位數、保形點方法與保形分位數回歸；1,945 條自願填報的保單記錄中 85% 用於開發與五折交叉驗證、15% 鎖進最終測試集，模型與超參數選擇只用開發數據；論文寫明「某些附近的提升樹候選在鎖住測試集的單項指標上表現略好，但測試集沒有被用來重選」；最終 90% 對數相對保形區間在鎖住測試集上的覆蓋率為 92.12%，平均寬度是保費的 1.11 倍；倉庫明確列出被排除的內容（原始與處理後的保單級數據、模型二進制、公司往來文件等），並寫明因此該公開倉庫無法獨立復現完整實驗
e.summary_en: A machine-learning master’s thesis project completed at the University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight: observable policy, aircraft and pilot attributes are used to estimate general aviation annual premiums, quantify prediction uncertainty and explain the model’s main drivers; the technical route compares baselines, GLMs, HistGradientBoosting, CatBoost and several XGBoost variants before selecting an ensemble combining a general log-premium model with segment-specific relative-premium models, and prediction intervals are tried as raw quantiles, conformal point methods and conformalized quantile regression; of 1,945 voluntarily entered policy records, 85% go to development and five-fold cross-validation and 15% is locked as the final test set, with model and hyperparameter selection using development data only; the thesis states that some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics but that the test set was not used for reselection; the selected 90% log-relative conformal interval reaches 92.12% coverage on the locked test set with a mean width of 1.11 times the premium; and the repository lists explicitly what is excluded, including raw and processed policy-level data and model binaries, noting that the public repository therefore cannot reproduce the complete experiment
e.body:
**aviation-premium-prediction**（仓库 `LaugeSolvang/Aviation-Premium-Prediction`）**是一份**通用航空保险（general aviation insurance）保费预测的机器学习硕士论文项目****：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 8,025 KB、创建于 2026-06-14、最后推送 2026-06-14**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**；**⚠️ 创建与推送**均在解冻窗口之前**——**见下方标注 ①**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 实测 404，README 亦无许可章节——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**；**topics 实测为** `aviation`、`conformal-prediction`、`insurance`、`machine-learning`、`master-thesis`、`shap`、`xgboost`；**README 实测 7,541 字节（英语）**；**仓库实测共 76 个条目**。**其自述逐字为**：**「A machine-learning master thesis project for estimating **general aviation insurance premiums**, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and explaining the model’s main drivers. The project was completed at the **University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight**.」**。本条目属于本轮主题**「单方面不成立」**中的**第一种，也是本站**首次填上「航空险」这一真空白形态**的条目****（**该形态在池 1189 ＋ wiki 1131 共 1400 条中命中数为 0，已连续约十轮为真空白**——**见标注 ②**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其评估设计一节是本条最值得记的一处，因为它把「锁住」写成了一条**用词极具体的纪律****——**逐字为**：**「The analysis used **1,945** voluntarily entered policy records: **1,653 policies (85%)** for development and five-fold cross-validation. **292 policies (15%)** in a **locked final test set**. **Model and hyperparameter selection used development data only.** **The locked test set was used once for final diagnostics, not to switch models afterward.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处各自拒绝一件事**：**① 85%／15% 划分是**先定后动**的**；**② **模型与超参数的选择只用开发数据**；**③ **锁住测试集**只用一次**，且只用于最终诊断**；**④ **「not to switch models afterward」——**不用于事后换模型****。**而**最能说明这条纪律真的是被遵守的**（而不是只在方法一节里声明）**是其在结果一节的**自陈**——**逐字为**：**「The ensemble was selected by development-side cross-validation. **Some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics, but the test set was not used for reselection.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**存在若干在锁住测试集上单项指标更好的候选，但作者没有据此改选****——**⭐ 这正与本轮主题相合：**锁住的第二来源只能**报告**，不能**挑选****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这 292 条在代码中是否确实只被读取一次**——**见标注 ⑥**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其预测区间的处理是第二条与本题相关的线索，且它把**覆盖率与宽度**的取舍如实摆出**——**逐字为**：**「The selected **90% log-relative conformal point interval** achieved: Locked-test coverage **92.12%**；Mean width relative to premium **1.11×**；Median width relative to premium **1.09×**」**；**以及**：**「**Raw quantile intervals were sharper but under-covered.** **Dollar-scale conformal intervals reached high coverage but became disproportionately wide for lower-premium policies.** The log-relative method provided the best development-side balance at the 90% target.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三句话构成一组很干净的取舍记录**：**原始分位数**更窄但覆盖不足**；**金额尺度的保形区间**覆盖达标但**对低保费保单宽得不成比例**；**对数相对尺度**在 90% 目标下取得最好的开发侧平衡**——**⭐ 对做定价与准备金区间的同学，这是一段可直接借用的对照**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其保形方法的实现与覆盖率计算**）。**③ ⭐⭐ **点预测结果一节的**基线阶梯**逐字可查**：**Test MAE **$1,309**、RMSE **$2,543**、MAPE **24.30%**、落在 ±15% 以内的比例 **41.10%****；**并逐字说明**：**「The selected ensemble reduced test MAE from **$3,973 for a global-median baseline** and **$2,130 for a hull-value-only model**.」**⭐⭐ **即**集成把测试 MAE 从「全局中位数基线」的 3,973 美元与「只看机身价值模型」的 2,130 美元压下来****——**⭐ 而**它也如实写出 MAPE 24.30% 与「±15% 以内仅 41.10%」**：**后者说明**多数预测并不在真值 ±15% 之内****（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实这些数字**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其对目标变量的**界定**很精确，且这一点对保险读者很重要**——**逐字为**：**「The target is **observed annual paid premium**, not actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost.」**⭐⭐ **即**因变量是**实际支付的年保费**，而不是精算纯保费或期望赔付成本****——**⭐ 本词条据此指出：这是一条**市场价格的拟合**，而非**风险的定价****；**其数据集与结论**均不能读作**任何险种的纯保费估计**（**其「限制」一节也逐字承认**：「Observed paid premium includes **market, carrier, broker, package, and underwriting effects that are not fully observed**.」**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其对**可解释性**的两处限定值得单独记**：**其一，最强全局驱动逐字为** **Hull value／Gear configuration／Deductible structure／Pilot experience, including hours in make and model／Aircraft make, year, and category**，**并逐字说** **「The directions were broadly consistent with aviation underwriting intuition.」**；**其二，其**非直觉发现**的处理方式最值得学**——**逐字为**：**「A non-intuitive **medical-coverage** pattern was treated as **a likely proxy for an unobserved carrier or policy package**, **not as a causal pricing rule**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**遇到一个反直觉的模式时，它的处理是**把它当成某个未观测变量的代理，而不是当成一条定价规律****；**并另逐字限定**：**「SHAP values describe how the fitted model uses observed variables. **They do not establish causal effects or official underwriting rules.**」**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读其 SHAP 结果表**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「可复现与隐私」一节把**被排除的东西逐项列出**，并直接说明后果**——**逐字为**：**「The source code, final aggregate result tables, thesis, and presentation are included. The following are **intentionally excluded**: Raw and processed policy-level data. UUID-level split assignments and prediction files. Local SHAP values and individual example-case tables. Trained `.joblib`, `.pkl`, and other model binaries. Company correspondence, meeting notes, legal documents, and internal review material.」**，**并逐字给出结论**：**「Because the confidential data and trained models are excluded, **this public repository cannot reproduce the complete experiment or run live predictions by itself. It documents the methodology and retained aggregate evidence.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「它记录方法与保留下来的汇总证据，而不能独立复现」是一句很克制的自我界定**——**⚠️ 与本轮其余三条候选（都以「能独立跑起来」为卖点）相反，**这一条明确说自己跑不起来**；**对做论文复现的同学，这正好是**「做不到什么」应当怎么写**的一个样本**。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其免责声明逐字，且把「不是什么」列全**——**逐字为**：**「> This is a **research and decision-support prototype, not a production pricing engine, binding quote system, or autonomous underwriting tool**.」**⭐⭐ **三项否定（不是生产定价引擎、不是有约束力的报价系统、不是自主核保工具）**——**⭐ 与第 334 轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的「不替代核心系统、不替代核保、不替代出单」属同一写法**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **其原型的形态逐字，且与「保单持有人只有自己那一份报价」这一起点相扣**——**其「Problem」一节逐字为**：**「**Aircraft owners often see only their own insurance quotes and have limited information for judging whether a premium is typical.**」**；**原型逐字含** **「A point estimate. An expected premium range. **Placement of the user’s paid premium within that range.** Model-driver and comparison guidance.」**⭐⭐ **即**把用户自己实际支付的那份保费放进模型给出的区间里给他看****——**⭐ 对做保险产品的同学，这是一个**把不确定区间转成用户可用的信息**的简单设计**；**⚠️ 并逐字说明该原型已不完整**：**「The retained HTML is the interface layer. **The public repository does not include trained model binaries, so calculations require the private model artifacts used during the thesis.**」**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **仓库结构与源码地图逐字，且**编号本身是实验流水线的痕迹****——**实测 `src/` 下 34 个文件**，**其中 20 个以 `rebuild_step_` 开头**（**`rebuild_step_01_scope.py` 至 `rebuild_step_06_feature_baseline.py`，再加 `07i`／`07r`／`07rd`／`07re`／`07s`／`07z`／`07zg`／`07zh`／`08ae`／`08v`／`08w`／`10` 等**）**；**README 逐字解释**：**「**The numbered filenames reflect the experimental pipeline used during the thesis.**」**；**另实测** **`docs/Lauge_Solvang_Master_Thesis_2026.pdf`**、**`docs/oral_defense_20min_presentation.pdf`**、**`thesis/thesis.tex`**、**`thesis/references.bib`**、**`thesis/figures/` 下 15 个图**、**`web/premium_tool.html`**、**`results/` 下 4 个 CSV 加 `README.md`**、**`requirements.txt`**⭐⭐ **即**论文 PDF、答辩演示 PDF、LaTeX 源与图、保留的汇总结果表、静态原型都在仓库里**；**⭐ 另有一处细节：`thesis/figures/supervisor_missing_01_pipeline_workflow.png`**（**文件名逐字说这是**导师说缺的那一张流程图**）**。**⑩ ⭐ 可与本站校准、保形预测与不确定性条目并读**：[[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[inforsight]]、[[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-conformal-risk]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[conformalprediction-jl]]、[[mapie]]、[[ratecraft]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **本条目的窗口位置必须写清，这是本轮**唯一一处对既定窗口纪律的例外****：**该仓库**创建与最后推送均为 2026-06-14，早于 2026-09-05 的解冻窗口****——**⚠️ 即它**不是**窗口内的新候选**；**⭐ 收录理由是**另一项：它填上了本站**连续约十轮为真空白的「航空险」形态****（**见下第②点**）；**⚠️ 本词条把这一取舍明确写出，供读者自行判断**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**放宽窗口纪律是对的，**只记录本轮为何在此破例一次**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **关于真空白的核实方式与限度**：**本条目的「航空险」归属由本站自有的 `form-gap-census.cjs` 判定**（**该工具的关键词为**启发式**：`aviation insurance`／`aircraft insurance`／`航空险`**），**而该工具在收录前对池 1189 ＋ wiki 1131（去重 1400 条）的普查结果为**「航空险 0」****——**⚠️ 但须同时写明：**「命中 0」只说明**此前没有任何条目的文本包含这三个关键词****，**不说明此前对该险种没有任何相关知识**（**例如第 333 轮的 [[aero-audit]] 触及航空但为**监控安全而非保险**，按当时日志已明确不计入该形态**）；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**本条已覆盖航空险的实务面**——**它是一份**保费拟合的学术项目**，**而**不是**航空险的条款、费率或核保研究**。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其数据来源与使用边界**——**README 逐字说数据为 **1,945 条**自愿填报的保单记录**，**来自与 ForeFlight 的合作**；**⚠️ 本次**未读其数据字典、未查 ForeFlight 或南丹麦大学的任何授权文件、未核实这些数据是否可以如此使用****；**本词条据此**不主张**其数据使用已获授权，**也不转述任何数据字段的含义**（**⭐ 其「可复现与隐私」一节已自述排除原始与处理后的保单级数据，并说明公开仓库无法独立复现**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其任何模型结果**——**包括 Test MAE 1,309 美元、RMSE 2,543 美元、MAPE 24.30%、±15% 以内 41.10%、90% 区间的 92.12% 覆盖率与 1.11 倍宽度、以及 SHAP 驱动因素排序**；**⚠️ 本次**未运行任何脚本、未读 `results/` 下任何 CSV、未读论文 PDF、未打开任何图****。**⑤ ⚠️⭐⭐ **未核实**其核心的「锁住测试集只用一次」是否在代码中确实成立**——**⚠️ 这恰恰是本条最需要被检验的一点**（**其自述「在某些锁住测试集指标上更好的候选未被用来重选」是一个**关于自己行为的声明**，**而这类声明只能由代码或记录来支持**）；**⚠️ 本次**未读任何 `src/` 下脚本、未查其提交历史、未读 `results/point_model_test_diagnostics.csv`**，**故**不主张**该纪律确实被遵守**（**⚠️ 对做建模的同学：**「我没有偷看测试集」是那种**无法从结果数字上验证**的声明**，**只能靠流程与留痕**——**而本条**同时提供了流程描述与保留的汇总结果表**，**这已是较强的证据形态，**但仍不等于核实****）。**⑥ ⚠️⭐ **未核实**其保形预测区间的实现与覆盖率口径**——**即**所用的是原始分位数、保形点方法还是保形分位数回归**、**分组与顺序如何取**、**以及 92.12% 的覆盖率是否按保单聚类计算**（**⚠️ 第 336 轮 [[inforsight]] 用了**聚类自助法**并说明了理由，**本条 README 未说明其区间是否处理同一保单的重复观测**——**这一点本词条**未核实，**仅提示为需查项**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（7,541 字节）全文、以及仓库全部 76 个条目的文件清单**（**含 `src/` 下 34 个文件与其中 20 个 `rebuild_step_*` 脚本、`docs/` 下两份 PDF 与 6 张图、`thesis/` 下 LaTeX 源、参考文献与 15 张图、`results/` 下 4 个 CSV 与 `README.md`、`web/premium_tool.html`、`requirements.txt`**）；⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 Python、未运行任何脚本、**未读任何源码、未读 `results/` 下任何 CSV、未读论文 PDF 或答辩演示、未打开任何图、未读 `web/premium_tool.html`、未查其提交历史或 issue****；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其与 ForeFlight 的合作关系、是否已通过答辩、论文是否已归档或公开发表**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该论文已通过评审、被 ForeFlight 采纳或具有任何商业或监管效力**；**⭐ 其自述为「master thesis project」与「research and decision-support prototype」，**本词条据此**不主张**它已用于任何真实报价或核保**。**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其任何结论适用于中国的通用航空或公务机保险市场**——**本次未查任何中国航空险条款、费率或监管规定**；**亦**不主张**其驱动因素排序（机身价值、起落架构型、免赔结构等）在任何其他市场成立**。**⑩ ⭐ **许可实测为**无**（`LICENSE` 404，README 无许可章节）**——**属「完全未声明」形态**；**⚠️ 本词条据此提示：其代码、论文源文件与结果表的可复用性**均需先向作者确认授权****（**⚠️ 其数据一节另已自述排除公司往来文件与法律文件**）。**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑫ **README **aviation-premium-prediction** (repository `LaugeSolvang/Aviation-Premium-Prediction`) **is a master’s thesis project on machine-learning prediction of general aviation insurance premiums**: **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, an 8,025 KB repository, created 2026-06-14 and last pushed 2026-06-14** (**all GitHub API measurements**; **⚠️ both creation and push fall *before* the thaw window — see note ① below**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404, and the README has no licence section — the "no statement whatever" form)**; **topics measured as** `aviation`, `conformal-prediction`, `insurance`, `machine-learning`, `master-thesis`, `shap` and `xgboost`; **the README measures 7,541 bytes and is in English**; **the repository measures 76 entries in total**. **Its self-description reads verbatim**: **"A machine-learning master thesis project for estimating **general aviation insurance premiums**, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and explaining the model’s main drivers. The project was completed at the **University of Southern Denmark in collaboration with ForeFlight**."** It is the first of this round’s four takes on **nothing stands on a single source**, **and it is the entry that finally fills the site’s "aviation insurance" true-zero gap** (**that form group measures 0 across the pool of 1,189 plus the wiki’s 1,131 — 1,400 deduplicated entries — and had been a true zero for roughly ten rounds; see note ②**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **Its evaluation-design section is the most notable point, because it writes "locked" as a discipline with unusually concrete wording** — **verbatim**: **"The analysis used **1,945** voluntarily entered policy records: **1,653 policies (85%)** for development and five-fold cross-validation. **292 policies (15%)** in a **locked final test set**. **Model and hyperparameter selection used development data only.** **The locked test set was used once for final diagnostics, not to switch models afterward.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four refusals**: **the 85/15 split is fixed before any work**; **model and hyperparameter selection use development data only**; **the locked test set is used once and for final diagnostics only**; **and "not to switch models afterward" — it is not used to change the model afterwards**. **What shows the discipline was actually kept, rather than merely declared in a methods section, is the admission in the results section** — **verbatim**: **"The ensemble was selected by development-side cross-validation. **Some nearby boosted-tree candidates performed slightly better on individual locked-test metrics, but the test set was not used for reselection.**"** ⭐⭐⭐ **candidates existed that scored better on individual locked-test metrics, and the author did not switch to them** — ⭐ **which is exactly this round’s theme: the locked second source may report, but may not choose** (**⚠️ whether those 292 records are in fact read only once in the code was not verified**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its treatment of prediction intervals is the second relevant thread, and it lays the coverage-versus-width trade-off out plainly** — **verbatim**: **"The selected **90% log-relative conformal point interval** achieved: Locked-test coverage **92.12%**; Mean width relative to premium **1.11×**; Median width relative to premium **1.09×**"**; **and**: **"**Raw quantile intervals were sharper but under-covered.** **Dollar-scale conformal intervals reached high coverage but became disproportionately wide for lower-premium policies.** The log-relative method provided the best development-side balance at the 90% target."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three sentences form a clean record of a trade-off: raw quantiles are sharper but under-cover; dollar-scale conformal intervals reach the coverage target but become disproportionately wide for low-premium policies; and the log-relative scale gives the best development-side balance at the 90% target** — **for students working on pricing or reserving intervals this is a directly borrowable comparison**. **③ ⭐⭐ Its point-prediction section gives the baseline ladder verbatim**: **Test MAE **$1,309**, RMSE **$2,543**, MAPE **24.30%** and **41.10%** of predictions within ±15%**; **and states verbatim**: **"The selected ensemble reduced test MAE from **$3,973 for a global-median baseline** and **$2,130 for a hull-value-only model**."** ⭐⭐ **the ensemble brings test MAE down from a global-median baseline of $3,973 and a hull-value-only model of $2,130** — ⭐ **while also reporting the MAPE of 24.30% and the ±15% figure of 41.10%, the latter showing that most predictions are not within ±15% of the truth**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its definition of the target variable is precise, and that matters to an insurance reader** — **verbatim**: **"The target is **observed annual paid premium**, not actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost."** ⭐⭐ **the dependent variable is the premium actually paid, not an actuarial pure premium or expected claim cost** — ⭐ **so this is a fit of market prices, not a pricing of risk;
